defenses.name: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
defenses.description: Protects administrative profiles and cloud accounts from unauthorized entry using dynamic session tokens.

defenses.name: Deploy Centralised Log Aggregation (SIEM)
defenses.description: Ingests active authentication logs, host event trackers, and firewall records into a security operations engine.

defenses.name: Implement Internal Network Segmentation
defenses.description: Isolates processing environments and host assets via internal state firewalls to block horizontal lateral hops.

defenses.name: Secure Email Gateways & Phishing Filtering
defenses.description: Applies heuristic body inspections, DMARC validation controls, and link parsing to corporate messaging boxes.

attacks.name: Spearphishing Threat Vector
attacks.description: An adversary targets internal HR contacts with custom malicious payloads hidden inside dynamic document objects.

attacks.name: SSH Perimeter Brute Force
attacks.description: Automated threat components scan open outward-facing nodes, triggering dictionary-based credential access scripts.

attacks.name: Obfuscated Script Execution
attacks.description: Malicious active processes generate localized, encrypted command-line statements attempting memory hijacking scripts.

attacks.name: RDP Lateral Movement Pivot
attacks.description: Having compromised a localized endpoint, the threat actor attempts remote service handshakes to bridge into core administrative nodes.
